title: A Vow for the Kitchen
author: Sebastian Ashgrove
blurb: Gideon Ishikawa, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
